title: Muda Rates Card
description: Per-item rework rate card consumed by 'muda statement --rates <card.json>'. Duplicate JSON keys are rejected.

currency.description: Three-letter ASCII currency code (for example USD, EUR, GBP).

revert.description: Unit price per joined revert commit.

fix-forward.description: Unit price per joined fix-forward commit.

redone.description: Unit price per joined redone commit.

decimal_rate.description: Non-negative ASCII decimal string with 1 to 30 integer digits and an optional decimal point followed by 1 or 2 fraction digits.
